verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲਾ ਸੀਤਲ ਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਸਿਆਮ ਗਹੈ ਪਰਸਿ ਤਪਤ ਪਰਦਗਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: koilaa seetal kar karat siaam gahai paras tapat paradhagadh karat hai ||

en.bdb: A burnt out coal when held in hand blackens it but causes burns when held if burning. (Coal is problematic both when cold or burning)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੇ ਚਾਟਤ ਕਲੇਵਰਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਛੋਤਿ ਕਾਟਤ ਸਰੀਰ ਪੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kookar ke chaaTat kalevareh laagai chhot kaaTat sareer peer dheer na dharat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as dog's lick is contagious and causes unbearable pain when it bites. (Dogs lick and bite both are troublesome).

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੂਟਤ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਗਰ ਪਰਤ ਹੀ ਪਖਾਨ ਫਰਿ ਪਾਹਨ ਪਰਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਗਾਗਰ ਹਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: fooTat jiau gaagar parat hee pakhaan far paahan parat pun gaagar harat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a pitcher breaks when dropped on a stone, and it also breaks when stone drops on it. (A stone is destroyer of a pitcher in every way).

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੰੂ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਬੁਰੋ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee asaadh sa(n)g preet ha(n)oo birodh buro lok paralok dhukh dhokh na Tarat hai ||388||

en.bdb: So is developing loving relationship with evil-minded persons. Loving him or showing dissent towards him is equally bad. Thus one cannot escape from pain and sufferings of this world and the world hereafter.  (388)
